[[File:Games necklace detail.png|left|140px]]
A '''games necklace''' is a [[sapphire necklace]] which has been enchanted using the [[Lvl-1 Enchant]] spell. It has 8 charges which can teleport the player to [[Burthorpe]],  [[Barbarian Outpost]],  [[Corporeal Beast]], [[Tears of Guthix (minigame)|Tears of Guthix]], and the [[Wintertodt Camp]]. After all 8 charges are used, the necklace will be destroyed.

When teleporting using the necklace, the message {{Mes|You rub the necklace...}} will be displayed, followed by a message with the number of charges remaining, ex. {{Mes|Your games necklace has three uses left.|colour=Purple}} If using the last charge on the necklace, the message {{Mes|Your games necklace crumbles to dust.|colour=Purple}} will be displayed instead. 

When a games necklace has one charge remaining, it is recommended not to use the last charge, but instead to save it and cast [[High Level Alchemy]] on it, as the necklace's alchemy value is irrespective of its charge.
